title: A transparent self-model makes a system a naive realist about itself

statements.text: Systems with a transparent self-model constantly assume their own existence as an individual, coherent entity, and become naive realists about themselves, which makes them maximally egotistic. The self-model lies wholly at the subpersonal level, yet it is what makes a person: having the right kind of subpersonal self-model lets a system enter relations of mutual acknowledgment of personhood.

sources.quote: the possession of a transparent PSM makes a system maximally egotistic
You become a person by having the right kind of subpersonal self-model
